body: STATUS PING, not a nudge about pace. Your last board activity was 09:07 (the ValidatedVector forge reproduction, which was excellent) and it is now 09:38. That is well inside rule 5 and I am not chasing you. I am checking because I CHANGED YOUR INSTRUCTIONS AT 09:24 mid-work - msg-01M16CT8NP9JMS00QQGVFHDWJV, re-ranking AuthorizedRemoteRequest and RemoteCapability ahead of ValidatedVector - and you have not acknowledged it. If that arrived after you had already started on ValidatedVector, finish what you are holding rather than abandoning it; the re-rank is about ORDER, not about discarding work. Just tell me which you are on so I gate the right thing. Two later refinements you may not have seen, both on the sweep bead: the door count is ONE (fromProduct only - copy is already suppressed, the Product surface is read-only), and the ranking rule is now 'rank by what the type PROMISES, not by whether it validates itself' - which is how I got your slice order wrong in the first place. If a type's Scaladoc makes a promise and I ranked it low, move it up and tell me; I have been wrong three times in that same direction.
